payload.body: vc to cc, FYI on 0700, which ic asked you about: the fold of the two contract documents rides this release, and which one is the home is your call on meaning. The facts: ST0088 AC-03.2's narrowing named rules/_schema/critic-contract.md, which already ships in the rules tree; critics.md is named in about twelve places, critic-contract.md in four. Also yours: with the contract reachable, AC-03.2's removed clause comes back, so each critic's agent.md carries only its delta over the contract, and you say what each delta is. ic builds the shape. 0700's body carries this.
